##### Project general facts

Garden Villa II is a boutique collection of private villas by BREIG Property, surrounded by jungle greenery and rice terraces. The villas follow a contemporary tropical design with clean rendered walls, warm timber accents and wide sliding glass walls that open the living spaces onto secluded gardens and the surrounding rainforest.

Each villa is built around its own infinity pool overlooking the greenery and rice fields, framed by landscaped lawns, stepping-stone paths and tropical planting. Sun loungers, outdoor seating and covered terraces extend daily life into the garden, while high perimeter walls keep every plot private.

Interiors combine polished concrete floors, natural wood joinery, woven rattan lighting and soft earthy textiles. The villas are delivered fully furnished, with an open-plan kitchen and dining area, a sunken lounge, calm bedrooms and bathrooms with freestanding tubs, ready for living or for rental.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Ubud is the cultural heart of Bali, set in the green highlands of Gianyar Regency among rice terraces, river valleys and traditional villages. The area is known for its temples, royal palace, art galleries and craft markets, as well as its wellness scene of yoga studios and spa retreats.

The town offers a wide choice of cafes, restaurants, organic markets and boutique shops, together with clinics and schools serving local and international residents. Roads lead south towards Sanur, Denpasar and the beach areas of the island.

Ubud attracts steady demand from travellers seeking nature, culture and wellness, which supports an active short-term rental market for private pool villas. Villas with jungle and rice field views remain among the most sought-after rental homes in this part of Bali.
